# dsh-computer-use
Codex-style **Windows computer use** for DeepSeek Harness: window-targeted UI Automation + occlusion
-tolerant screenshots + SendInput mouse/keyboard injection, exposed as five model-facing tools and b
acked by a bundled long-lived PowerShell helper.
While computer use is active, a click-through **screen overlay** draws a vivid "liquid glass" look:
a sapphire *edge vignette* (fully clear center, satin-navy darkening toward the four screen edges) w
ith a thin cyan glass rim hugging the display border, plus a "dynamic island" status pill at the top
center — sapphire gradient, diagonal sheen, bright rim, breathing blue glow: `DeepSeek Harness 正在操控
你的电脑 | 按 ESC 终止`. Pressing **ESC** stops computer use immediately and closes the overlay; the agent
is told to stop and reports back.
Designed after the OpenAI Codex Windows Computer Use surface (`list_apps` / `get_window_state` / `cl
ick(element_index | x,y)` / `press_key` / `type_text` / `scroll` / `drag` / `set_value` / `activate_
window`, X11-keysym-style key names, one action then re-observe), reimplemented as a pure DSH plugin
with no third-party runtime dependencies.
## What you get
| Tool | Purpose |
| `computer_list_windows` | List targetable top-level windows (window_id, process identity, title, r

ect, foreground/minimized, policy-blocked flag). Optionally lists Start-menu launchable apps. |
| `c
omputer_observe` | Capture one window state: screenshot (default) and/or UI Automation tree with ele
ment indexes, focused element, selection, document text. Returns `state_id` + screenshot coordinate

mapping. |
| `computer_action` | Exactly one action against a state: click / double_click / right_cl
ick / middle_click / mouse_move / type / key / scroll / drag / set_value / wait / activate_window. |
| `computer_launch_app` | Launch by exe path, exe name, Start-menu display name, `.lnk`, or `shell:

AppsFolder\<AUMID>`; reports the windows it opened. |
| `computer_sequence` | Run up to 100 ordered
input steps on one window without re-observing between them (absolute screen pixels) — for repetitiv
e GUI work such as drawing a diagram; optionally returns one verification screenshot. |
Plus the click-through status overlay with the **ESC kill switch** (`USER_ESCAPE`), a system-prompt
section (workflow, hard denies, confirmation policy) and a `computer-use` skill with the full playbo
tion (workflow, hard denies, confirmation policy) and a `computer-use` skill with the full playbook.
## Requirements
- Windows 10/11, interactive user session (not a service session), PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe`

— pwsh 7 not required).
- DSH 0.2.x (web/desktop profile; any composition that mounts `tools`, `syst

emPrompt` and `attachments` — the shipped base mounts all three).
- No native modules, no npm depend
encies, no MCP server.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- The helper is spawned lazily on the first computer-use call (`powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonIntera
ctive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File helper\ComputerUseAgent.ps1`), serialized (input injection must
not interleave), subject to per-request timeouts, restarted after crashes, and killed on plugin disp

ose or idle.
- **Overlay**: on the first desktop request the helper starts a separate STA PowerShell
/WPF child (`CuOverlay.ps1`) that draws two click-through, topmost, capture-excluded windows on the
primary display — a radial **liquid-glass edge vignette** (clear center → satin-navy edges) with a t
hin cyan glass rim along the screen border, and a sapphire-gradient **dynamic-island** pill with a d
iagonal sheen, bright glass rim and a breathing blue glow. The material is implemented with per-pixe
l-alpha WPF gradients only (no DWM acrylic/blur APIs, no full-screen animation, no global keyboard h
ook) — the vividness comes from color and layering, not from fragile OS effects. The plugin keeps a
heartbeat file fresh on every tool call and every session event of the active turn; the helper refre
shes it while a sequence/wait runs; the overlay hides itself when the heartbeat goes stale, when the

turn ends, when the helper dies, or when the user presses ESC.
- **ESC kill switch**: the overlay p
olls `GetAsyncKeyState(VK_ESCAPE)` (≈80 ms). On ESC it writes `escape.json` and closes; the helper t
hen aborts an in-flight `sequence`/`wait` and answers any further request with `USER_ESCAPE`, and th
e plugin refuses every `computer_*` tool for the rest of the turn. The stop clears automatically whe
n the session log shows a new `user/message` after the ESC timestamp (i.e. the user has spoken again

), so the next task works without a restart.
- Screenshots are written to `%TEMP%\dsh-computer-use`,
committed as durable DSH image attachments (`ctx.attachments.saveImage`), returned as image content

blocks, and deleted unless `keepScreenshots`.
[该节后续省略]
## Limitations (deliberate, v1)
- Window-targeted only: no full-desktop or multi-monitor panorama (per-window capture is safer and s

impler; coordinates remain unambiguous). The overlay likewise covers the **primary display** only.
-
The overlay is decoration and a kill switch, not a control surface: it never takes focus or clicks,
is excluded from screen capture, and cannot pause/resume the agent itself (ESC always means "stop t

his computer use").
- No clipboard read/write, no file dialogs auto-fill, no multi-point drag paths

(single straight drag), no `perform_secondary_action`, no hold-key.
- Accessibility trees are best-e

ffort and bounded (600 elements / depth 12 by default) — very large trees truncate.
- The helper is
PowerShell-based for zero-binary distribution; first call pays compilation cost. A native helper wou

ld be faster but is a distribution/security tradeoff.
- The helper must run in the user's interactiv

e session: RDP-disconnected/locked sessions and secure desktops are refused by design.
- English too
l descriptions, Chinese-friendly safety messages; confirmation policy is model-enforced except for t
hinese-friendly safety messages; confirmation policy is model-enforced except for the approval seam.
